description: This file implements a Kubernetes FlexVolume plugin, defining plugin structures, initialization, support checks, and volume management functions.

classes.name: flexVolumePlugin
classes.description: Represents a Kubernetes FlexVolume plugin with configuration and capabilities.

classes.name: flexVolumeAttachablePlugin
classes.description: Extends flexVolumePlugin to support attach/detach operations.

methods.name: NewFlexVolumePlugin
methods.description: Factory method to create a new flexVolumePlugin instance, probing capabilities.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the host environment.

methods.name: GetVolumeName
methods.description: Retrieves the volume name from the spec, with fallback support.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports the given volume spec.

methods.name: NewMounter
methods.description: Creates a new volume mounter for the specified pod.

methods.name: NewUnmounter
methods.description: Creates a new volume unmounter for the specified volume and pod UID.

methods.name: NewAttacher
methods.description: Creates a new attacher for attachable volumes.

methods.name: ConstructVolumeSpec
methods.description: Constructs a volume specification for the given volume name and mount path.
